messages.author: 13e7a89818964e05
messages.subject: abline.text.axis
parts:
波松分配
size=500
lambda=2
repn=200
t=0.01
for (i in 1:repn){
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
(ds<-rpois(size,lambda))
plot(sum(ds),ylim=c(lambda*5/6,size*lambda*7/6),xlab="x",ylab="車輛總和")
abline(h=c(size*lambda,size*lambda+2*sqrt(size*lambda),size*lambda-2*sqrt(size*lambda)),
lty=2,col=c("red","blue","gray"))
text(1.3,size*lambda+sqrt(size*lambda),sum(ds)-(size*lambda))
axis(4,at=c(size*lambda+2*sqrt(size*lambda),size*lambda-2*sqrt(size*lambda)),
round(c(size*lambda+2*sqrt(size*lambda),size*lambda-2*sqrt(size*lambda)),0))

plot(sum(ds)/size,ylim=c(lambda*5/6,lambda*7/6),xlab="x",ylab="平均車輛數") 
abline(h=c(lambda,lambda+2*sqrt(lambda/size),lambda-2*sqrt(lambda/size)),
lty=2, col=c("red","blue","gray"))
text(1.3,lambda+sqrt(lambda/size),round(sum(ds)/size,3))
axis(4,at=c(lambda+2*sqrt(lambda/size),lambda-2*sqrt(lambda/size)),
round(c(lambda+2*sqrt(lambda/size),lambda-2*sqrt(lambda/size)),2))
Sys.sleep(t)}
二項分佈
size=1000
repn=200
p=0.5
for (i in 1:repn){
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
ds <- rbinom(size,1,p)
plot(table(ds),xlim=c(-1,2),ylim=c(0,size*2/3),xlab="x",ylab="次數")
abline(h=c(size*p,size*p+2*sqrt(size*p*(1-p)),size*p-2*sqrt(size*p*(1-p))),
lty=2, col=c("red","blue","gray"))
text(1.5,size*p+sqrt(size*p*(1-p)),sum(ds==1)-(p*size))
axis(4,at=c(size*p+2*sqrt(size*p*(1-p)),size*p-2*sqrt(size*p*(1-p))),
round(c(size*p+2*sqrt(size*p*(1-p)),size*p-2*sqrt(size*p*(1-p))),0))
plot(table(ds)/size,xlim=c(-1,2),xlab="x",ylim=c(0,2/3),ylab="相對次數")
text(1.5,p+sqrt(p*(1-p)/size),round(sum(ds==1)/size-p,3))
abline(h=c(p,p+2*sqrt(p*(1-p)/size),p-2*sqrt(p*(1-p)/size)),
lty=2, col=c("red","blue","gray"))
axis(4,at=c(p+2.5*sqrt(p*(1-p)/size),p-2.5*sqrt(p*(1-p)/size)),
round(c(p+2*sqrt(p*(1-p)/size),p-2*sqrt(p*(1-p)/size)),2))
Sys.sleep(0.05)}

剛開始學R，對於abline.text.axis這三項的寫法有些困惑，完全看不懂老師的解答，麻煩大家，幫我看一下！！謝謝

Hi friend,

依序輸入以下三個指令會有完整線上說明, 其中 abline 加上直線, text加上文字, axis加上刻度(1:下,2:左,3:上,4:右)
?abline
?text
?axis
